resources.string: Click or Drag the \'Chomp\' command to advance the Pacbot and chomp a dot. The program fails if there is no dot to chomp.
Click or Drag the \'Turn\' one of the turn command to rotate the Pacbot in place.
Press play to run your program. If your Pacbot eats all the dots then you will advance to the level stage.
Program your Pacbot to eat all the dots
